items.title: Remove the fixed-length truncation so late-diverging rejection reasons keep distinct digests
items.context: packages/main/src/core/convergence-breaker.ts:479 truncates the normalized reason to 200 characters before hashing. ProofStory gap lists share a preamble longer than that, so two different gaps hash identically. Hash the full normalized reason, retaining only a large sanity bound to cap CPU on pathological input.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/convergence-breaker-smoke.js prints a passing check stating that two real DEV-gate rejection renders differing only past the former 200-character cut produce different digest keys.

happy.desc: gateFailureDigest applied to two reconstructions of the real DEV-gate rejection render (machine.ts:179 preamble plus renderProofStoryDiagnosticReport), identical for their first 244 normalized characters and differing only in the outstanding gap codes, returns two different keys.
The same two rejections routed through bumpGateFailureCount leave maxGateFailureCount at 1, so assessBreaker does not trip, which is the actual operator-visible consequence.

edge.desc: A rejection reason far longer than any realistic gate message still produces a digest, and the retained sanity bound is exercised rather than silently absent.
Two reasons that are identical up to the sanity bound and differ only beyond it are documented as collapsing, so the bound's residual behavior is stated rather than assumed away.

adversarial.desc: Restoring only the fixed-length truncation makes the new smoke assertions fail, proving the check is bound to this change and not to some unrelated property.

verificationEvidence.note: NOT DELIVERED AS ORIGINALLY WRITTEN, recorded as such: the C1 class was fixed on main by B-cc54, whose 200-character prefix and signals-fold this branch adopts untouched. What this story delivers of the item is bounded and named: 'must-differ signal-less-long-rejection [guard: signals-conditional-prefix]' widens the prefix when a rejection yields no signals. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-differ signal-less-long-rejection [guard: signals-conditional-prefix]' drives the real bumpGateFailureCount and asserts the counter consequence, not the hash alone. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

Two cases pin the prefix-window residual, both guard prefix-window-residual: 'scope-extension-proposal-ordinal-past-window' and 'requirement-ordinal-past-window'. The second is an honest cost of this design reported by the implementer: req- is allowlisted and its id IS protected, yet its only story_advance-reachable producer at core/proofstory.ts:1026 renders it inside a ProofStory report whose fixed banner already exceeds the 200-character cut, so the pair collapses anyway. Measured relaxation bound: widening to 592 leaves B-cc54 green, 600 breaks it; 200 is kept for byte-compatibility, not because no relaxation exists. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

The residual from the other side: 'must-differ scope-extension-proposal-ordinal [guard: substantive-id-whole-token]' asserts the within-window pair distinct. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-differ proofstory-gap-signal-set [guard: signals-fold]' guards against regressing B-cc54's mechanism: identical 200-character prefixes with different non-empty signal sets must digest differently; collapsing basis to prefix alone fails exactly that case. The earlier claim that 'bcc54-cross-vendor-noise' served this purpose was false and is retracted. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

items.title: Narrow the path normalizer to machine-specific absolute roots only
items.context: packages/main/src/core/convergence-breaker.ts:475 rewrites any slash-bearing token, collapsing DEV/REVIEW with DEV/TEST and src/core/alpha.ts with src/core/beta.ts. Restrict it to absolute paths anchored at machine-specific roots so relative repo paths and slash-bearing identifiers stay distinct while host-varying paths still collapse.
items.userSees: The convergence-breaker smoke prints passing checks stating that DEV/REVIEW and DEV/TEST digest differently, that two files under a shared first path segment digest differently, and that the same lock path under /Users and under /private/var still digests identically.

happy.desc: Two rejection reasons differing only in a slash-bearing identifier (the phase pair DEV/REVIEW versus DEV/TEST) produce different digest keys.
Two rejection reasons naming different repo-relative files under a shared first segment (src/core/alpha.ts versus src/core/beta.ts) produce different digest keys.

edge.desc: The same logical lock path rendered under a machine-specific root (/Users/... versus /private/var/...) still produces one digest key, so host-varying paths keep collapsing.
A path that begins at a machine-specific root but continues into repo-relative segments is normalized once, without leaving a partially-rewritten remainder that could differ per host.

adversarial.desc: Restoring the greedy slash-anchored regex makes the new distinctness checks fail while the machine-path collapse check keeps passing, proving both directions are independently bound to this change.

verificationEvidence.note: 'must-differ phase-pair [guard: path-rule-overreach]' asserts DEV/REVIEW and DEV/TEST digest differently, printing both compared values literally. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-differ in-repo-file-path [guard: path-rule-overreach]' asserts two files under a shared first segment digest differently. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-still-collapse machine-absolute-path' and 'delimiter-attached-absolute-path' [guard: path-rule-collapse] assert host-varying absolute paths, including those introduced by a colon, equals or comma, still share one key and still trip the brake. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-still-collapse machine-path-into-repo-relative-segments [guard: path-rule-collapse]' asserts a path continuing from a machine root into repo-relative segments is consumed in one match. Since the id guard became a whole-token test, a machine path can no longer be protected as an id under any circumstance, so the id rule and the path rule no longer interact at all. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

Two revert-proofs, one per direction, re-derived from scratch after the whole-token change: widening the path rule to main's slash-anywhere form fails the path-rule-overreach cases, and deleting the path rule fails the path-rule-collapse cases. No subset was carried forward from an earlier round. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

items.title: Narrow the numeric normalizer to standalone numbers only
items.context: packages/main/src/core/convergence-breaker.ts:476 rewrites digit runs inside identifier tokens, collapsing CHK-001 with CHK-002. Restrict it so digits attached to an identifier survive while free-standing counters such as attempt numbers still collapse.
items.userSees: The convergence-breaker smoke prints a passing check stating that a rejection naming CHK-001 and one naming CHK-002 digest differently, alongside a passing check that two attempts differing only in a free-standing counter still digest identically.

happy.desc: Two rejection reasons differing only in an identifier-embedded ordinal (CHK-001 versus CHK-002) produce different digest keys.

edge.desc: Two rejection reasons differing only in free-standing counters and an ISO timestamp still produce one digest key, so genuine retries of one failure keep accumulating.
A story id such as B-bf52, whose digits are attached to an identifier, survives normalization, so rejections naming different stories are not conflated.

adversarial.desc: Restoring the unconditional digit-run rewrite makes the identifier-ordinal distinctness check fail while the free-standing-counter collapse check keeps passing.

verificationEvidence.note: 'must-differ checklist-ordinal' and 'checklist-ordinal-at-reason-start' [guard: substantive-id-allowlist], plus 'finding-ordinal' and 'unfixed-bug-ordinal', assert that an ordinal naming WHICH lifecycle artifact failed survives normalization. Five further must-differ cases prove the whole-token test is not TOO strict, each guarded by the rule it exercises: 'open-blocking-finding-delimiter-attached-id' (qualifier), 'excluded-keyword-parenthesized-item-id' and 'embedded-test-output-bracketed-and-quoted-id' (leading-punctuation strip), 'checklist-not-done-comma-list' and 'scope-extension-proposal-sentence-final-period' and 'blocking-finding-desc-semicolon-attached-id' (trailing-punctuation strip). Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-still-collapse bare-attempt-ordinal [guard: digit-rule-collapse]' asserts two attempts differing only in a free-standing counter still share one key and still trip the brake, matching the frozen userSees; 'lease-heartbeat-age' and 'lane-counts' extend the same direction. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, as a WHOLE SET against the current matrix; the command names the suite that actually demonstrates the claim.

'must-differ scope-extension-proposal-ordinal [guard: substantive-id-whole-token]' asserts a compound artifact id keeps its trailing ordinal; M6 fails exactly that case. Three review-bookkeeping cases pin the converse — 'stale-review-run-evidence', 'review-loop-ordinal', 'init-check-issue-ordinal' — because each id is re-minted or retyped on retry. Four cases guard the token boundary against real embedded test output: 'embedded-test-output-hyphen-compounds', 'embedded-test-output-slash-joined-names' and 'embedded-test-output-doubled-prefix' [guard: substantive-id-token-start], plus 'embedded-test-output-digit-letter-tail' [guard: substantive-id-token-end]. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, and as a WHOLE SET — partial re-recording left sibling notes self-contradicting once before (F-045/F-046/F-047).

Revert-proofs by named mutation, each re-derived on an immutable build: the exact pre-F-048 regex fails exactly 'embedded-test-output-slash-joined-names' and 'embedded-test-output-doubled-prefix' and nothing else; weakening the leading guard alone fails the slash case; dropping the doubled-prefix lookahead alone fails the doubled case; reverting the leading guard to a word boundary fails those two plus 'embedded-test-output-hyphen-compounds'; narrowing the token-start class to start-or-whitespace fails 'open-blocking-finding-delimiter-attached-id'; dropping the trailing word boundary fails 'embedded-test-output-digit-letter-tail'. M7 (allowlist emptied) fails the four substantive-id cases; M8 (b- added) fails 'bcc54-story-id-digits' here and CHK-002:adversarial:2 in B-cc54's suite; M9 (rr-/rp-/rl- added) and M14 (i- re-added) fail the review-bookkeeping cases. M5b (ISO and digit both deleted) aborts at a section-7 assertion before the matrix and names no case — recorded as it behaves. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, and as a WHOLE SET — partial re-recording left sibling notes self-contradicting once before (F-045/F-046/F-047).

items.title: Extend the convergence-breaker smoke with a substantive-versus-incidental digest matrix
items.context: packages/main/src/tasks/convergence-breaker-smoke.ts:180-182 asserts distinct reasons do not accumulate but uses fixtures too short and too plain to reach any collapse rule. Add the four must-differ cases (long-preamble ProofStory gaps, phase pair, checklist ids, in-repo file paths) and the three must-still-collapse cases (timestamps and attempt counters, machine-specific absolute paths, hex digests), each driving the real bumpGateFailureCount and maxGateFailureCount path so the counter consequence is proven, not just the hash.
items.userSees: npm run test:convergence-breaker exits zero and its output lists the must-differ and must-still-collapse digest cases by name, each reporting the resulting gate-failure counter value rather than only the hash.

happy.desc: Every must-differ case drives the real bumpGateFailureCount path twice and then asserts maxGateFailureCount is 1, proving the counter consequence rather than only the hash inequality.
npm run test:convergence-breaker exits zero from a clean build, so the matrix is reachable through the root full test suite that gates DONE.

edge.desc: Every must-still-collapse case drives bumpGateFailureCount twice and asserts maxGateFailureCount reaches 2 and assessBreaker still trips, proving the breaker keeps catching a genuine repeat.
The pre-existing assertions in this smoke, including the reset-clears-counter case, keep passing unchanged alongside the new matrix.

adversarial.desc: Each of the three normalizer changes reverted individually causes a named subset of the matrix to fail and leaves the rest passing, so the matrix localizes which rule regressed instead of failing as one opaque block.

verificationEvidence.note: Every must-differ case prints keys=2 counter=1 breaker=proceed, each driving the real bumpGateFailureCount twice and reading back maxGateFailureCount and assessBreaker. The closing banner derives its inventory from the case arrays, so a printed count cannot drift from the matrix. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, and as a WHOLE SET — partial re-recording left sibling notes self-contradicting once before (F-045/F-046/F-047).

Ran from a clean build in the worktree and exited zero, confirming the matrix is reachable through the root npm test chain that lattice.config.json lists as a doneRequiredCommand. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, and as a WHOLE SET — partial re-recording left sibling notes self-contradicting once before (F-045/F-046/F-047).

Every must-still-collapse case prints keys=1 counter=2 breaker=trips, proving the brake still catches a genuine repeat: three machine-path shapes, both B-cc54 fixtures, three review-bookkeeping ids, four embedded-test-output token-boundary shapes, the past-window residual, bare attempt ordinals, lease heartbeat ages, lane counts, hex ids and ISO timestamps. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, and as a WHOLE SET — partial re-recording left sibling notes self-contradicting once before (F-045/F-046/F-047).

Case coverage in this suite: the pre-existing assertions still pass alongside the matrix, including the reset-clears-counter case, and the section-7c completeness guard is BIDIRECTIONAL — it names an UNCLASSIFIED prefix when a scanned producer has no entry, and a NO PRODUCER entry when a declared prefix has none, so enumeration drift is caught by the suite rather than by the next review round. Command rebound after F-050: those claims live in this suite. The separate B-cc54 boundary claim is verified by its own command, 'node packages/main/dist/tasks/gate-repeat-block-smoke.js' exiting 0 with 'git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/gate-repeat-block-smoke.ts' empty, reported by every reviewer lane this round.

A differential probe against a freshly built main covers 26 pairs from immutable worktree copies: zero pairs where the branch collapses what main distinguishes, zero where it distinguishes an ordinal that is not retry-stable. Every rule mutation localizes to its own tag group, and the measured-overlaps block in the suite records the table; its first draft mis-attributed two cases and was corrected against measurement before commit. Recorded by case name and guard tag, no hand-written totals, and as a WHOLE SET — partial re-recording left sibling notes self-contradicting once before (F-045/F-046/F-047).
